newsitem.title: MOZAMBIQUE: Thieves leave Mozambican airport in the dark.
newsitem.headline: Thieves leave Mozambican airport in the dark.

text.p: Mozambique's international airport in Maputo may have to close at night unless thieves can be stopped from stealing runway lights, airport director Felismino Charas said.
The Maputo daily Noticias quoted Charas as saying on Wednesday that 23 runway lights and their casings were stolen last weekend and aircraft had to land with minimum lighting.
Charas said the lights were stolen every weekend, even though police were deployed at the airport.
"Given the condition the airport's main runway is in today, if 10 more lamps are stolen, we may have to close down the airport at night...," he said.
"How can they trust us if we have an airport without lights, and therefore unable to receive night flights, and inter-continental flights are usually at night," Charas said.

In March, thieves stole a generator from the airport premises just a few metres (yards) from a police post. The generator was recovered when the thieves tried to sell it and the buyer became suspicious.
